items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: At the Oasis, when Wendell Marshall... Yeah, I sat in with the band.

ctx.x: Oh, it was maybe two or three times, whenever he'd have a bass problem. But the fact that he thought enough of me to want me in his band really satisfied my ego, because he might have let me play the tuba and do the things I wanted to do, but I didn't think there was much of a chance for me to do much writing for Duke Ellington. So I stuck to my guns. I have no regrets. Just the fact that he wanted me was enough.
You sat in with the band a few times.
